title: Final Surge Plan Compliance Below Eighty Percent
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=finalsurge:workout
bin _time span=1w
stats avg(compliance_pct) as compliance by athlete _time
where compliance<80
description: Surfaces weeks where completed Final Surge workouts materially missed prescribed duration or intensity.
value: Surfacing final surge plan compliance below eighty percent helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant fitness & activity tracking export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It treats when final surge plan compliance below eighty percent matters for your routine.
